identity.summary: An attacker uses the File Server Remote VSS Protocol (FSRVP) to create a shadow copy of a remote system's volume, enabling lateral movement and data exfiltration. Cortex should detect this behavior vi
identity.description: An attacker uses the File Server Remote VSS Protocol (FSRVP) to create a shadow copy of a remote system's volume, enabling lateral movement and data exfiltration. Cortex should detect this behavior via process creation and network activity.

payload.code:
net use \\192.0.2.10\ADMIN$ /user:Administrator
vssadmin create shadow /for=C:
\vss\vssadmin.exe create shadow /for=C:\
\vss\vssadmin.exe list shadows

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious FSRVP Usage
biocs.description: Detection of vssadmin.exe being invoked with shadow creation commands on Windows systems
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'vssadmin.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'create shadow'

abiocs.name: Suspicious FSRVP Usage
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where vssadmin.exe is used to create shadow copies on remote systems
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'vssadmin.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'create shadow'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
abiocs.causality_anchor: vssadmin.exe process start with shadow creation command
